text:
alex: Quick heads-up — trying to push release/3.4.2 to prod in the 21:00-22:00 change window. Data team lead doesn't have prod deploy role. Can someone confirm approval flow?
maria: Who on data needs to run it? We should avoid granting long-lived perms.
charles: We have the JIT flow now — request ephemeral role via https://internal.apps/rbac/jit. It creates a 1-hour role with MFA check.
alex: Ah cool. Is the MFA check enforced for JIT?
charles: yes, the portal forces SMS or TOTP step. On top of that, deploy-bot still requires at least one human approver from prod-approvers group for cross-team deploys.
alex: @deploy-bot can you show current approvers for prod-approvers?
deploy-bot: approvers for channel eng-releases: maria, jen. Current queued requests: 0.
jen: I can approve this one but need the release notes + rollback plan in thread first.
alex: release notes: "3.4.2 — fix KV cache overflow, backfill sharded prefix cache, minor config bump". Rollback: revert to 3.4.1 tag, run db-migrate --rollback, and set routing to canary=0 immediately.
oncall-sre: confirm SLO impact: rolling deploy expected 40s median token latency increase for ~2 minutes during warmup. No expected errors.
maria: manual checklist before jen approves:
```
- ensure changelog in /releases/3.4.2
- pinned model manifest v2.1 confirmed
- smoke tests green on staging
- canary window set to 10m
- ops contact in thread
```
charles: note: if the requester doesn't have JIT enabled, we can do an approver-elevate: i.e., approver manually triggers the deploy via their account after approval. That keeps no-write perms for requestor.
alex: I have JIT token request submitted (request id 7842). Portal asked for TOTP, got token.
jen: I reviewed release notes and rollback steps. Approving on condition: canary at 5% for first 10m, automatic rollback on error-rate >2% or latency >2x baseline. Approving now.
deploy-bot: Deployment requested by alex: /deploy release/3.4.2 --env prod --canary 5 --auto-rollback on. Waiting final confirmation from trigger.
alex: Running deploy now -> `/deploy release/3.4.2 --env prod --canary 5`
deploy-bot: Deploy started. Canaries: 5% traffic. Targets: 4 GPU workers. Tokens: 124k. Logs: https://deploys.internal/1718456789
maria: monitoring dashboard up, watching latency and error spikes. If anything goes wrong, rollback using `/deploy rollback release/3.4.1` and ping this thread.
charles: small follow-up: ops, please add a short note in runbook about the JIT timeout mismatch we hit last week (portal gave 45m token but deploy sometimes needs 60m). I'll file a ticket. :memo:
alex: ack, i'll monitor and report. Thanks all :thumbsup:
